sentences.text: His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by the coordinate Bench by order dated 21.01.2021 passed in M.Cr.C. No.2767/2021.
His second bail application was dismissed on merits by order dated 03.12.2021 passed in M.Cr.C. No.58198/2021 by the coordinate Bench.

His third bail application was dismissed on merits by order dated 30.11.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.56331/2022 with direction to the prosecution to produce evidence of constable-Rajesh Shukla and head constable female- Seema which as per learned counsel for the applicant has been recorded.
The applicant has been arrested on 27.08.2020 by Police Station- Chirula District Datia M.P.) in connection with Crime No.95/2020 for the offence punishable under Sections 302, 376 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station- Chirula District Datia M.P.)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In brief, case of the prosecution is that on 23.08.2020, Motiram gave an information at Police Station Chirula District Datia that his sister/prosecutrix marriage was solemnized 22 years back with Santram Kevat.
After her marriage, she had gone to her in-law's house only two times.
Thereafter she had started residing at her paternal home.
On 23.08.2020 when complainant was on duty, in the morning at 6 am, one Ravi informed him that dead body of his sister/prosecutrix is lying down in the river.
He reached there and saw the dead body.
On his information, Merg No. 6/20 was recorded.
Dead body panchnama was prepared.
Dead body was sent for postmortem.
As per postmortem report, she died due to asphyxia.
Death of the deceased was homicidal.
The vagina of the deceased was found to be torn.
During argument, it is informed by learned counsel for the applicant that FIR was registered against present applicant on the basis of inquiry conducted under Section 174 CrPC.
O n being asked about statements recorded during merg inquiry in the present matter, learned counsel for the State replied that the same is not available in case diary.

sentences.text: Despite direction issued by this Court on previous occasion, neither statements recorded under Section 174 CrPC nor inquiry report has been annexed with the case diary due to which today arguments on application application could not be concluded.
The Superintendent of Police, Datia is directed to remain present before this Court on 22.02.2023 alongwith the statements recorded under Section 174 CrPC and inquiry report.
List this case on 22.02.2023.
A copy of this order be supplied to learned counsel for the State for compliance.
A copy of this order be sent to Additional Director General of Police, Chambal Zone, Gwalior for necessary compliance.
(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE ojha Man Singh@
